_meta.description: Test payloads for M-SLACK-ALERTS webhook. Send via POST to the generated webhook URL with Content-Type: application/json. Each key is a named test scenario.
_meta.usage: Select the scenario key you want to test and POST that object's value to the webhook.

new_lead_sss._description: SSS brand new lead alert. Expect: message in #sss-leads with sailboat icon, all metadata fields rendered.
new_lead_sss.message: New lead received from Webflow for brand SSS

new_lead_mare_executive._description: MARE EXECUTIVE brand new lead alert. Expect: message in #me-leads (NOT #sss-leads). Confirms brand-based channel routing.
new_lead_mare_executive.message: New lead received from API for brand MARE_EXECUTIVE

new_lead_duplicate._description: Duplicate lead alert (LOW urgency). Expect: message in #sss-leads with urgency=LOW. Confirms duplicate flag is visible in message.
new_lead_duplicate.message: Duplicate lead re-submitted from Manual for brand SSS — existing record updated

booking_created._description: Booking created alert. Expect: :new: *Booking Created* message in #sss-bookings.
booking_created.message: New booking created for Marina Delacroix — Aug 10 charter party of 6.

booking_confirmed._description: Booking confirmed alert. Expect: :white_check_mark: *Booking Confirmed* message in #sss-bookings.
booking_confirmed.message: Booking confirmed for Marina Delacroix — contract signed and deposit requested.

deposit_received._description: Deposit received alert. Expect: :moneybag: *Deposit Received* message in #sss-bookings.
deposit_received.message: Deposit of $4,000 received for Marina Delacroix booking via Stripe.

stripe_link_sent._description: Stripe payment link sent alert. Expect: :link: *Stripe Payment Link Sent* message in #sss-bookings.
stripe_link_sent.message: Stripe payment link sent to marina.delacroix.test.new@example.com for $4,000 deposit.

concierge_assigned._description: Concierge assigned alert. Expect: :bust_in_silhouette: *Concierge Assigned* message in #sss-ops (NOT #sss-ops-alerts).
concierge_assigned.message: Concierge Sophie Laurent assigned to Marina Delacroix booking. Charter date: Aug 10.

automation_error._description: Automation error alert. Expect: :rotating_light: *Automation Error* message in #sss-ops-alerts (NOT #sss-ops).
automation_error.message: M-BOOKING-CREATION failed to create booking record. Airtable returned 422 Unprocessable Entity. Retry 3 of 3 exhausted.

emergency._description: Emergency alert. Expect: :rotating_light: message in #sss-emergency-ops AND a direct Slack DM to Will (WILL_SLACK_USER_ID_PLACEHOLDER).
emergency.message: Stripe webhook processing halted. All payment events unprocessed for 30 minutes. Immediate intervention required.
